subject: ACCEPTED RISK: 377's no-session completability can only be verified in production
description: Raised by Nancy, then required in writing by Chris during the 377 gate 2026-09-09. The end-to-end claim -- 'a visitor with no session can now finish a box' -- cannot be proven anywhere except hexworth.com. The Identity Toolkit API key carries an HTTP-referrer restriction: both http://127.0.0.1:<port> and Firebase preview channels (hexworth-prime--<channel>.web.app) are rejected with auth/requests-from-referer-<origin>-are-blocked, so signInAnonymously fails for an ENVIRONMENT reason and the no-session arm of _tools/hexos/nt1-completable-as-user.test.js cannot go green off production. WHAT IS PROVEN WITHOUT PRODUCTION: (a) the sign-in gate, at the network layer, by _tools/hexos/box-flag-auth-gate.test.js, which aborts every identitytoolkit request so the browser physically cannot mint an account while the attempt is still counted -- immune to the referrer restriction because it measures intent, not outcome; (b) on production, in a fresh no-session context, that await ArenaFirebase.ensureAuth() then BoxEngine.requestFlagText() returns a real flag{...} -- the exact sequence the fix performs internally. The gap is only the INTEGRATION of those two halves. OPTIONS TO CLOSE IT PROPERLY: (1) add the preview-channel domain pattern to the API key's allowed referrers (a Google Cloud console change, needs operator authorization, and widens who can call the key); (2) build an auth+firestore EMULATOR arm as task 372 did at _tools/hexos/anon-load-signin-emulator.test.js -- the emulator is not subject to the real key's referrer restriction; NEVER start the functions emulator, it loads functions/.env and has fired live Discord webhooks. Until one of those exists, every 377-class change must be verified by running nt1-completable-as-user.test.js --no-signin against production IMMEDIATELY after deploy, with a revert ready. Option 2 is the right investment and is the reason this is logged rather than left as a silent gap.
